dimensions.note: secret keeps its sensitive flag through both .optional() wrappers and the new credentials wrapper. secretRef holds names, not values, so its checker warning is accepted inline. An {env} value goes to the redactor as soon as it is read. Problems, YAML errors and read errors repeat no field values, with sentinel tests.
Structured placeholders throughout. The audit logs its probed and unprobed counts on entry and the outcome on completion. No secret is logged.

The audit throws before any write on an invalid manifest, and the sweep writes misconfigured. Open: the comment on resolveCredentials says it never throws, but an undefined repoDir or a non-string path gives a TypeError. The CLI supplies both, and a failed step still alerts. Tracked for a follow-up release.

143 tests, success and failure paths, with 21 of 21 mutation controls caught, plus a fixture audit and refusal cases through the real CLI. Open: no test for the empty-string subject branch or for the sweep's cap of 10 problems. Tracked for a follow-up release.
Read-only. Re-running rewrites the same resources. An invalid manifest refuses the run before anything is written.
No new HTTP calls. The manifest is the new external input: its shape is checked and each entry goes through CredentialInputSchema.
The only new I/O is one readTextFile, which opens and closes its own handle. No new connections or temporary files.
Fixtures and README examples use invented ids, vaults and paths. Denylist check over the diff and commit messages: 0 hits.
No passthrough. secretRef and manifest are strict objects. Resource schemas gain defaulted fields only, so older audit resources still validate.
Resource specs unchanged; each keeps lifetime and garbageCollection.
A read-only monitor with no resource lifecycle.
No mutating methods. The existing id preflight now also runs over every monitored manifest id.
Duplicate ids and resource-name clashes are refused across all monitored entries, probed or not, and credentials cannot take the audit or sweep instance names.
Methods read no stored state back.
2026.11.03.1 has an upgrades entry with a no-op upgradeAttributes. It documents the additive fields and the one compatibility exception, a secretRef with an extra key.
